question.knowledge_point: Identifying the Trendline of a Given Scatter Plot
question.problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13938989/assets/294e45be62260374df597915428bf83ac676ce709d727a7d194755cb73d78b72.png)

The scatter plot above shows the correspondence between the distance of a house from the nearest public transport facility and its price, in thousands of dollars, among a sample of newly built homes. Which of the following is the trend line of the scatter plot?
question.worked_solution:
The plot shows that the data points are scattered along a curve, not a straight line.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13938989/assets/e4654e24215c05554c4985cccc2dcce5f6579de537a6218f4b859f13ff276a29.png)

Therefore, there is no linear trend in the data.

choices.value: There is no linear trend in the data
